decisions.reason: Having stayed visible after launch and fitting the firm's core dental thermoforming workflow, this line likely meets a satisfactory aspiration level and a large firm's slack supports keeping it.

This PETG blank is a close complement to the firm's digital and laboratory production business, so continued offering suggests acceptable performance relative to aspiration and little pressure to reallocate resources.

The lacquer appears more peripheral and less prominently positioned than the main material lines, so its aspiration attainment is less certain, but the firm's breadth and innovation orientation still favor retention unless performance clearly disappoints.

Custom hearing protection earmolds match the firm's established hearing-care capabilities and specialist channels, and their continued presence indicates results likely remain good enough to avoid problemistic search and withdrawal.
